title: Track the Thief
description: The trail leads to Darkwood Grove. Everything on the merchant's list turns up in the thieves' camp except one small locked case - and the one left alive swears he was paid to take that case alone and told to leave the rest of the stall untouched. Recover what you can.

objectives.description: Track the theft to Darkwood Grove
Deal with whoever's still holding the goods
Recover the stolen goods - what's left of them

notes: Soulstone touchpoint (docs/design/quest_web.md #4): the small locked case is the one thing not recovered, and the thief says he was paid for it alone. Never named, never explained, gates nothing.
